title: Exceptional theta correspondences via Plancherel formulas for rank one symmetric spaces
summary: We consider the minimal representation of (a finite cover of) the conformal group of a simple split Jordan algebra over $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, whenever it exists. The conformal group contains a natural dual pair $G\times G'$, where $G$ is essentially the automorphism group of the Jordan algebra and $G'$ is either $\operatorname{PSL}(2,\mathbb{R})$, $\operatorname{PGL}(2,\mathbb{R})$ or $\operatorname{PGL}(2,\mathbb{C})$.
